Confirms distributions across the listed preferred issues; no dividend amounts or changes from prior payments were provided.
Series M and N payable Dec. 15, 2026
Payment timing is set for holders of record at the close of business Nov. 30, 2026.
Series A, C, E, F, I, K, L, O, P and Q holders of record Dec. 31, 2026 are eligible.
This is a routine distribution update, with no stated change to dividend amounts or policy. The next relevant details would be any future dividend declarations or disclosed changes to the payments.
